authority: Measured native joint hierarchy, rest-world transforms and dominant-weight vertex regions; anatomy.json retains every local TRS and joint order.

nodeMap.17: ground-origin root with pelvis skin influence, NOT a hip-position root
nodeMap.7: chest and shoulder branch; dominant vertices y 0.694–0.849
nodeMap.2: negative-native-lateral elbow/forearm/hand influence; no wrist child
nodeMap.4: lower staff influence, NOT a wrist: weighted bounds y 0.002–0.399 and width x 0.03245

coordinatePolicy.forward: Normalize horizontal mean of measured ankle-to-toe vectors (9−10 + 13−14); foot geometry, not generic bone names, defines forward.
coordinatePolicy.lateral: up cross forward; positive projects toward provider-left hip12 from hip16. Literal anatomical left/right still requires parent visual review.
coordinatePolicy.units: Preserve all native units/TRS. Parent-approved game normalization is1.70m playable height, not provider real-world size; runtime parent applies measured1.7360917117448456 scale exactly once, no mesh scaling baked into derivative.
coordinatePolicy.rootMode: in-place-authoritative-capsule: native root never carries net horizontal travel. Measured reference root curve is evidence only and MUST NOT additionally move the actor.
coordinatePolicy.simulation: evasion quick_step_left distance1.45m,15 action ticks,12 recovery ticks at60Hz; CombatEngine currently applies displacement instantaneously. Continuous reference contacts do not assert current gameplay contact.
coordinatePolicy.staff: Keep node5→4 local transforms fixed and modest chest tilt; no attack, strike, lethal silhouette or guessed wrist animation. Staff/hand surface landmarks are measured weighted mesh regions, not new skin joints.

contactPolicy: Idle: both sole regions planted for whole loop. Dodge: brief anticipation/push, airborne lateral transfer, provider-left landing followed by provider-right settle and recovery. Foot IK uses real chain lengths and world rest ankle orientation. Maximum planted sole displacement budget0.025m; report measured values even if failed.
